fieldNotes.location: Confirmed Anheuser-Busch Newark Brewery, 200 US-1, Newark NJ. Roster coords were ~2.4 km off (movedMeters 2445). Locked center on the main brewhouse/warehouse mass at 40.69400,-74.19250. Identity confirmed by the brewing complex (brick brewhouse, grain-silo tank farm), extensive trailer yards, and the 86-acre footprint on Route 1 between rail lines and Newark Liberty Airport - matching the property described in the $360M Goodman Group sale.
fieldNotes.operatingStatus: IMPORTANT - the Newark brewery (opened 1951, AB's 2nd-oldest) CLOSED in early 2026 and the 86-acre site was SOLD to Goodman Group for ~$360M (deed filed March 2026); Goodman plans an industrial/logistics redevelopment. As of the audit date (May 2026) the facility is no longer operating as a brewery. Audit reflects the physical yard infrastructure from pre-closure imagery.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Large fenced industrial campus - chain-link perimeter fence confirmed in Street View along the E (Route 1 access road) building face. Multiple controlled access points (truck yard entrances on the N/NE plus a campus entrance off the E access road); exact gate structures not positively imaged.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A guarded entry is standard for an AB brewery of this scale and age; small structures sit near the trailer-yard entrances, but a truck-gate guard booth could not be positively confirmed at z20 - medium confidence.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Distinct truck-yard entrances at different points of the property line (N trailer yard vs E access road) - treated as separate entry/exit points.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Ample internal circulation and stacking room within the large campus.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors with backed-in trailers along multiple building faces; ~45 estimated, 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Multiple very large trailer yards on the N and NE sides holding ~150 trailers in marked rows; 50+ band, capacity ~250.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on separate building faces.
fieldNotes.railServed: Multiple rail lines run along the W edge with sidings into the property at the tank farm - clearly rail-served.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: brewhouse with grain-silo tank farm, multiple packaging warehouses, ancillary buildings.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Newark / Newark Liberty Airport industrial fabric within the NYC metro - Urban.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively identified - flagged uncertain.
